dataset.alignment: same sentence id in both test sets; require one unique English reference

selection.recording_rule: one Chinese recording per id; ascending sha256(20261114:recording:filename)

pipelines.name: dubbing
pipelines.input: actual translation_gold English output; full ASR-to-dubbing is covered by five video workflows

pipelines.name: video_delivery
pipelines.input: first five selected recordings wrapped with recorded licensed background footage
pipelines.via: real source upload, localization jobs, CAS application and FFmpeg render
pipelines.scope: derived business workflow test; FLEURS supplies audio/text, not original video annotations

metric_implementations.translation: mjpost/sacrebleu; chrF word_order=2, English BLEU tokenizer=13a; record package version and metric signatures
metric_implementations.speech_errors: jitsi/jiwer; freeze normalization and retain raw hypotheses

rules: reference English is scoring-only and never enters translation prompts
freeze sample ids before model outputs
report all twenty requests including failures and missing outputs
record initial and final text when a duration rewrite occurs
separate automatic quality metrics from delivery success rates
editing and localization run concurrently through separate analysis/localization/render workers

full_suite.real_contracts: temporary database migrations, text/image/video embeddings and reranker, native planner schema/truncation, ASR recovery/silence, translation, TTS, persistent jobs/cache/CAS, concurrency and invalid inputs
full_suite.core_deadline_profile: actual core structured-generation service, identified through its health response

stability.starts_from: fresh analyzed licensed source; excludes ASR/planning latency

full_suite.existing_public_editing: fresh regression of four previously inspected public tasks; one attempt per task; unchanged official judges

evaluation_scope: Development regression on the same inspected twenty FLEURS samples and four public editing tasks

runtime_overrides.narrative_review: actual-boundary audit and confirmed actor-state precedence
runtime_overrides.narrative_draft: greedy, user-provided thematic arc or actor-state causality; unchanged independent boundary review
